convertibility_reason: Uses JFATL custom indicator via iCustom, which has no built-in MT5 Python equivalent. Requires reimplementing or sourcing the JFATL algorithm in Python. Double MA component is auto-convertible but JFATL dependency makes overall conversion manual.

custom_logic_notes: EA combines double MA crossover with JFATL custom indicator for trend confirmation. JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) is a smoothed adaptive trend filter - signals likely require both MA crossover AND JFATL trend alignment. Digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers is typical for this EA class. Exact parameter values, period calculations, and whether JFATL is used as entry filter or primary signal could not be confirmed from binary file.
python_conversion_notes: JFATL is a custom Jurik-based indicator not available in standard Python libraries. Must either: (1) reimplement JFATL algorithm in Python using Jurik smoothing formulas, (2) find a Python Jurik library (e.g. jurik.py on GitHub), or (3) pre-compute JFATL values in MT5 and export as CSV for backtesting. The MA crossover component is trivial to convert with pandas/numpy. Digit adjustment logic must be handled: check if _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 then multiply SL/TP by 10. New bar detection needs to be reimplemented using timestamp comparison on bar data.
